Goal: Prove the runtime walks, branches, judges per item, and replays.

Know this before acting:
- list_items -> judge_items: One ask per word.
    avoid: Judging all words in one ask.
- judge_items -> report: Report non-colors as warnings.
    avoid: Dropping unparseable answers silently.

Is the word "red" a color? Answer only JSON: {"is_color": true or false}
